description.en: Activity of engaging a third part as part of an Archaeological Project. This could be a formal First Nations Consultation, or an informal engagement with a FN or other third party.

nodes.description: Person initiating the engagement. Typically the Arch Branch, but could be the proponent, or some other party if not part of a formal Consultation (eg for pre-engagement).
nodes.name: Engaging Party

nodes.description: Period, in days (eg 30, 60, 90) of the engagement (consultation) duration
nodes.name: Engagement Period

nodes.description: Formal Consultation, Informal Engagement (eg pre-engagement) others?
nodes.name: Engagement Type

nodes.description:
Indicates that the engagement is considered to be complete and satisfied for the purposes of satisfying the Permit Application requirements
To satisfy BT- BRQ - FN30, ticket #1769.
We may want to change to a Reference datatype (Unstarted, In Progress, On Hold, Complete?)
nodes.name: Is Complete

nodes.description: The party that is being contacted as part of the engagement (typically a First Nation, Band or Tribal Council).
nodes.name: Engaged Party

subtitle.en: Act of engaging with a third party as part of a BCAP managed project
